title: Blissful Almond Treat
description: A sweet and crunchy vegetarian treat made with almonds and a hint of bliss
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Spread the sliced almonds on the baking sheet.
Bake for 10 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
In a small saucepan, heat the bliss over low heat.
Add the sweet treat (dark chocolate chips) to the saucepan and stir until melted.
Remove the almonds from the oven and let cool slightly.
Drizzle the bliss-chocolate mixture over the almonds.
Allow to cool and harden before serving.
